title: New law: A bill to authorize the President of the United States to present on behalf of the Congress a specially struck gold medal to John Wayne. (Public Law 96-15)
summary: S. 631 of the 96th Congress became Public Law 96-15 on 1979-05-26.

title: New law: Pension Policy Commission Act (Public Law 96-14)
summary: S. 532 of the 96th Congress became Public Law 96-14 on 1979-05-24.

title: New law: A joint resolution to confer certain powers on the Presidential Commission appointed to investigate the Three Mile Island nuclear powerplant accident. (Public Law 96-12)
summary: S.J.Res. 80 of the 96th Congress became Public Law 96-12 on 1979-05-23.

title: New law: A joint resolution to authorize and request the President to proclaim the week of May 6 through 12, 1979, as "National Historic Preservation Week". (Public Law 96-13)
summary: S.J.Res. 71 of the 96th Congress became Public Law 96-13 on 1979-05-24.

title: New law: An act to amend the Council on Wage and Price Stability Act to extend the authority granted by such act to September 30, 1980, and for other purposes. (Public Law 96-10)
summary: H.R. 2283 of the 96th Congress became Public Law 96-10 on 1979-05-10.

title: New law: A joint resolution to declare May 18, 1979 to be "National Museum Day". (Public Law 96-11)
summary: H.J.Res. 262 of the 96th Congress became Public Law 96-11 on 1979-05-18.
